subject: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request

Team —

Quick ask: I want to request approval for a one-time headcount slot (1x Technical Lead, Runtime) and a limited comp-band exception to onboard a time-sensitive candidate we identified through TalentBridge. High level:

- Role: Technical Lead — Runtime (focus: kernel optimizations, KV cache durability)
- Why now: Candidate has previous infra runtime lead experience and can shorten our performance roadmap by ~3 months if we hire quickly.
- Compensation ask: midpoint + 12% above band (details in attached comp-band-exception-proposal.pdf).
- Funding: We can dip into the Q4 runtime capacity reserve (see hc-priority-matrix.xlsx). Net incremental run-rate ~ $34k/year.
- Timeline: offer in the next 72 hours to secure candidate; hiring window tight.

Attachments: hc-priority-matrix.xlsx, comp-band-exception-proposal.pdf, candidate-resume-priya-shah.pdf

Ask: Kimberly/Laura — can I get provisional approval to extend an offer at the proposed level and push HR to open REQ-2026-419? If we can move fast, we avoid a 6–9 month delay recruiting for a rare skill set.

If useful, I can summarize the tech tradeoffs and fallback (promote from within / convert contractor) in a 10-minute sync.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Platform — Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request

Sergio —

Thanks for the note. A couple quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) What is the 12% delta in absolute annualized comp (base + expected bonus)? Please put the run-rate delta on a 12-month basis.
2) Can this be deferred to the next hiring tranche, or is the risk of losing the candidate material if we wait 2–3 weeks?
3) Any internal conversion options (we have a senior contractor on infra who could be considered) — cost to convert vs external hire?

If you can provide those points in the next day I can escalate to Finance for provisional approval.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Talent & Compensation

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request

Kimberly / Team —

Short answers from the hiring-manager perspective:

- Absolute delta: ~ $34,200 run-rate (base + target bonus). See comp breakdown on page 2 of comp-band-exception-proposal.pdf.
- Candidate urgency: TalentBridge flagged that Priya has multiple late-stage conversations with two other infra-led companies and they want a decision this week. She has specific kernel + quantization experience that matches our 99th percentile perf use-cases.
- Internal conversion: The senior contractor (A. Gomez) could be promoted, but that would only buy us partial coverage on kernels — we would still need external hire for cross-platform quantization experience. Conversion cost is similar but slower (notice + ramp).

Recommendation: Approve a provisional offer at the requested level and open REQ-2026-419 with a 30-day conditional hiring window. If we lose the candidate, we re-evaluate converting the contractor.

I am ready to join any quick call to walk through specifics.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Runtime Engineering (hiring manager)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request

Team —

Technical note from infra side:

- Priya's background looks strong for the kernel/attention optimizations we are targeting. If we commit to an expedited onboarding plan (pairing with Kernel Team for first 6 weeks, dedicated project milestones), we can realistically capture the 3-month acceleration Monica cited.
- Risk: fast hire + aggressive onboarding increases short-term operational pressure on the kernel maintainers; plan to mitigate: two-week knowledge transfer and overlap budgeted in the matrix.

Given the performance ROI and limited incremental run-rate, I support the provisional approval on the condition we define the onboarding milestones and commit a two-week overlap budget in the HC tracker.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Infrastructure

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request

Sergio / team —

Provisional approval granted. Conditions:

- Limit: single-band exception (12%) and must be documented in the comp file.
- Funding: draw from Q4 runtime reserve; confirm impact on next quarter forecast.
- Onboarding plan: must include the milestones Marcus requested and a 2-week knowledge transfer overlap.

Kimberly — please issue provisional offer language and instruct HR to open REQ-2026-419. Sergio / Monica — once offer is accepted, route a final note to Finance for the permanent budget update.

Appreciate the tight turn on this.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
COO, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Tran <alyssa@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-time runtime slot + comp-band exception request

Thanks all — confirming next steps and status:

- Kimberly: please move forward with provisional offer at the approved level and flag the single-band exception in the comp file.
- Alyssa / TalentBridge: please send Priya the provisional offer tonight; include the attached resume and the expedited onboarding note.
- Monica & Marcus: I updated the HC tracker (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Runtime-HC-Tracker) and added the two-week overlap budget per Marcus.
- HR REQ: REQ-2026-419 opened (link: https://hr.redwood.ai/requisitions/REQ-2026-419).

I will follow up with Finance routing for the permanent budget change after candidate acceptance.

Closing the loop here — I will move the thread to the "Approved" folder once offer is out.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Platform — Runtime
Redwood Inference
